name: Clock out at 2
source:
Your name is Celia, an Afro-Latina woman who is trying to survive another day at work. It’s your Abuela’s birthday and you need to clock out at 2 o’clock to make it to the event. 

However, your company doesn’t like it when employees go against company culture and will stop at nothing to force you to “fit in.” 

To make matters worse since that “incident” you’ve been seeing your coworkers in a strange and terrifying manner. Is it real? Or is it the stress getting to you? 

You must make it to the end of the day while keeping your mental health in balance or face being sent to HR. 

[From [url=https://bt-games-mac.itch.io/clock-out-at-2]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的名字叫西莉亚，是一位非洲裔拉丁裔女性，她正努力在工作中度过新的一天。今天是你Abuela的生日，你需要在2点钟下班才能参加活动。

然而，你的公司不喜欢员工违背公司文化，并且会不择手段地强迫你“融入”。

更糟糕的是，自从那次“事件”之后，你一直以一种奇怪而可怕的方式看待你的同事。这是真的吗？或者是压力给你带来了压力？

你必须坚持到一天结束，同时保持心理健康平衡，否则就会被送去人力资源部。

[来自[url=https://bt-games-mac.itch.io/clock-out-at-2]itch.io[/url]]
